item.tib: sa bdag 'khrug bcos yid bzhin ljon pa'i phreng ba
item.coloph: 'di ni rgyal ba'i lung don sems la zhugs/ bden pa chen po 'khrul med dag pa'i bka'/ kho bo o rgyan bde chen gling pa yis/ ma nor ci bzhin bkod pa ma gtogs pa/ ci dran gang shar ma yin khungs lung btsun/ lag len gsal ba'i yi ge ris su bri/ snyigs ma'i dus su byin rlabs shin tu che/ rkang gnyis mi la bde legs kun 'byung na/ gto mkhan gsar bu rnams la bzhag pa yin/ 'gal mchis bshag la dge mchis 'gro la bsngo/ mang ga lam//
